entries.id: Search Party outside Black Pine Silver Mine Shaft B
entries.defaultTitleString: Search Party outside Black Pine Silver Mine Shaft B
entries.descriptionText: Here we can see John in a rare photo with the Mounties Search Party in July 1901 before starting work in the Old Silver Mine at Black Pine, he is normally on the other side of the lens!
entries.captionText: John Baxley and the Mounties search party outside Black Pine Silver Mine Shaft B, July 1901

entries.defaultTitleString: Preface of Mysteries of the Old North West
entries.captionText: The preface of Hannah Fletcher's New Book "Mysteries of the Old North West"
entries.descriptionText: The preface of Hannah Fletcher's Investigative book "The Mysteries of the Old North West" is shown in this photo.  It looks an interesting book from what you gleam from this introduction.
